title: Richness Is Not Evenness: Ordered Renyi Crossings under Self-Training
abstract: arXiv:2611.08892v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recursive self-training of language models, a setting studied in model collapse, can reduce vocabulary while making frequent words, mostly function words, less dominant. We fine-tune English GPT-2 on its own output for nine generations, vary the training-data sampling temperature, and measure every model with one fixed sampler. As training temperature rises, Renyi entropy changes turn from loss to gain at distinct temperatures: min-entropy first, then collision entropy, Shannon entropy and observed richness. Between the outer crossings, word types fall while the most-common word becomes less dominant. Untruncated training at T = 1 lies in this interval: at 13,000 words, generation 9 has 24% fewer types than generation 0 yet collision entropy is 0.91 bits higher. The ordering persists with a finer grid, different measurement samplers, a fixed word budget and five fresh training seeds. Min-entropy again crosses before richness in four furt

translated_title: 丰富性并非均匀性：自训练下的雷尼熵有序交叉
translated_abstract: 语言模型的递归自训练——模型坍缩研究中考察的一种设定——能够在缩减词汇量的同时，降低高频词（主要是功能词）的主导程度。我们让英文GPT-2在自身输出上进行九代微调，改变训练数据的采样温度，并用同一固定采样器测量每个模型。随着训练温度升高，各阶雷尼熵的变化在不同的温度点依次由损失转为增益：最小熵最先发生交叉，随后是碰撞熵、香农熵和观测丰富度。在最外侧两个交叉点之间，词类型数量下降，而最常用词的主导性却在减弱。T=1下的未截断训练恰好位于该区间：在13,000词的规模上，第9代的词类型数量比第0代少24%，但碰撞熵却高出0.91比特。这一排序在更细的温度网格、不同的测量采样器、固定的词预算以及五个全新的训练种子下均保持不变。在另外四种设定中，最小熵同样先于丰富度发生交叉（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文通过九代GPT-2递归自训练实验首次发现不同阶雷尼熵存在有序的温度交叉点，证明词汇丰富性与分布均匀性是两个相互独立的维度：词类型数量减少的同时，高频词的主导性反而降低。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals an ordered sequence of Rényi entropy crossings under recursive self-training of GPT-2, demonstrating that vocabulary richness and distributional evenness are distinct phenomena—word types can decline while the most frequent words become less dominant.
